objective: Freeze the badf-security-design capability contract as DESIGNED: a thin G05 security-DESIGN composition/router that consumes the architecture + solution baselines, models abuse, derives controls and security requirements, and normalizes specialist outputs into the EXISTING G05 design artifacts (threat-model / privacy-assessment / supply-chain-plan). business_value: G05 has evidence types but no capability to author them coherently. It captures the OWASP ecosystem's value as reference methodology without turning BADF into an OWASP wrapper or letting a scanner grant a gate.
